raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A Kimi-K3 request with a strict tool fails with HTTP 400 when the tool's `parameters` use a `$ref` that points into the root structure instead of into `$defs`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["value"],
  "properties": {
    "value": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "a": {"type": "string"},
        "b": {"$ref": "#/properties/value/properties/a"}
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```
Failed to compile structural_tag grammar: ... json_schema_converter.cc: Cannot find field value in #/properties/value/properties/a
```

The Kimi-K3 tool-call format emits each argument separately, so the structural tag compiles each argument value as its own JSON schema. A ref such as `#/properties/value/...` is then resolved against the argument schema, which no longer has that path. Refs into `$defs` / `definitions` are unaffected, because every argument schema already carries the root's definition pools.

## Modifications

All changes are in `function_call/kimik3_structural_tag.py`:

- `_is_root_structure_ref` tells a local ref into the root structure apart from a ref into `$defs` / `definitions`.
- `_localize_root_refs` copies every root-structure ref target into the argument schema's `$defs` under a fresh `root_ref_<n>` name and rewrites the ref to point there.
  - Root-structure refs inside a copied target are copied the same way, so ref chains and recursive schemas resolve.
  - Each ref is copied once.
  - Refs that do not resolve are left in place for the compiler to report.
- `_argument_value_variants` applies it to each type-restricted argument schema before compiling it. A schema without root-structure refs is returned unchanged.

## Tests

`test_kimik3_structural_tag.py` gains two tests:

- `test_strict_schema_resolves_refs_into_the_root_structure` covers three kinds of ref:
  - a ref to a sibling property,
  - a ref to an array's `items`,
  - a chain that mixes `$defs` and root-structure refs.
- `test_strict_schema_resolves_recursive_root_structure_refs` covers an `items` ref back to the argument itself.

Each test checks that a valid value is accepted and a wrongly typed one is rejected. Both tests fail on main and pass here with the pinned xgrammar 0.2.7. The rest of `test/registered/unit/function_call/` gives the same results before and after the change.

detail.title: [Fix] kimi-k3: Resolve strict tool $refs into the root parameters schema

files.patch:
@@ -209,6 +209,61 @@ def _with_root_definitions(
     return result
 
 
+def _is_root_structure_ref(ref: Any) -> bool:
+    # Every argument schema carries the root's definition pools; other local
+    # refs point into the root's own structure, which an argument schema lacks.
+    return (
+        isinstance(ref, str)
+        and (ref == "#" or ref.startswith("#/"))
+        and not ref.startswith(("#/$defs/", "#/definitions/"))
+    )
+
+
+def _localize_root_refs(
+    schema: Union[bool, Dict[str, Any]], root_schema: Dict[str, Any]
+) -> Union[bool, Dict[str, Any]]:
+    # Each argument value compiles as its own schema, so every root-structure ref
+    # target is copied under its $defs and the ref rewritten to point there.
+    if not isinstance(schema, dict):
+        return schema
+    pools = [schema.get(key) for key in ("$defs", "definitions")]
+    taken = {name for pool in pools if isinstance(pool, dict) for name in pool}
+    names: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    pending: List[str] = []
+
+    def rewrite(node: Any) -> Any:
+        if isinstance(node, list):
+            return [rewrite(item) for item in node]
+        if not isinstance(node, dict):
+            return node
+        result = {key: rewrite(value) for key, value in node.items()}
+        ref = node.get("$ref")
+        if _is_root_structure_ref(ref) and (
+            ref == "#" or _resolve_local_ref(ref, root_schema) is not None
+        ):
+            if ref not in names:
+                index = len(names)
+                while f"root_ref_{index}" in taken:
+                    index += 1
+                names[ref] = f"root_ref_{index}"
+                taken.add(names[ref])
+                pending.append(ref)
+            result["$ref"] = f"#/$defs/{names[ref]}"
+        return result
+
+    result = rewrite(schema)
+    if not pending:
+        return schema
+    hoisted: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    while pending:
+        ref = pending.pop()
+        target = root_schema if ref == "#" else _resolve_local_ref(ref, root_schema)
+        hoisted[names[ref]] = rewrite(target)
+    defs = result.get("$defs")
+    result["$defs"] = {**(defs if isinstance(defs, dict) else {}), **hoisted}
+    return result
+
+
 def _restrict_schema_type(
     schema: Union[bool, Dict[str, Any]],
     json_type: str,

+def _value_tool(value_schema, **extra):
+    return Tool(
+        type="function",

+            name="emit",
+            strict=True,
+            parameters={
+                "type": "object",
+                "required": ["value"],
+                "additionalProperties": False,
+                "properties": {"value": value_schema},
+                **extra,
+            },
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def _accepts_value(grammar, value):
+    return _accepts(
+        grammar,
+        _tools_section(_call("emit", 1, _argument("value", "object", value))),
+    )
+
+
+def test_strict_schema_resolves_refs_into_the_root_structure():
+    sibling = _grammar(
+        [
+            _value_tool(
+                {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "a": {"type": "string"},
+                        "b": {"$ref": "#/properties/value/properties/a"},
+                    },
+                }
+            )
+        ],
+        tool_choice="required",
+    )
+    assert _accepts_value(sibling, '{"a":"x","b":"y"}')
+    assert not _accepts_value(sibling, '{"b":1}')
+
+    items = _grammar(
+        [
+            _value_tool(
+                {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "list": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
+                        "one": {"$ref": "#/properties/value/properties/list/items"},
+                    },
+                }
+            )
+        ],
+        tool_choice="required",
+    )
+    assert _accepts_value(items, '{"list":["a"],"one":"b"}')
+    assert not _accepts_value(items, '{"one":2}')
+
+    chained = _grammar(
+        [
+            _value_tool(
+                {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "a": {"$ref": "#/$defs/S"},
+                        "b": {"type": "integer"},
+                        "c": {"$ref": "#/properties/value/properties/b"},
+                    },
+                },
+                **{"$defs": {"S": {"type": "string"}}},
+            )
+        ],
+        tool_choice="required",
+    )
+    assert _accepts_value(chained, '{"a":"s","b":1,"c":2}')
+    assert not _accepts_value(chained, '{"c":"two"}')
+
+
+def test_strict_schema_resolves_recursive_root_structure_refs():
+    tree = {
+        "type": "object",
+        "properties": {
+            "kids": {
+                "type": "array",
+                "items": {"$ref": "#/properties/value"},
+            }
+        },
+        "additionalProperties": False,
+    }
+    grammar = _grammar([_value_tool(tree)], tool_choice="required")
+    assert _accepts_value(grammar, '{"kids":[{"kids":[]},{}]}')
+    assert not _accepts_value(grammar, '{"kids":[{"kids":[1]}]}')
+
